csv_project_name: Feasibility Study for SR 5 Paving Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: SR 5/US-1/S DIXIE HWY/GRADE SEPARATION AT NE 186TH STREET. This contract will be to conduct a feasibility study for the grade separation at the Florida East Coast Railway (FEC) crossing of SR 860/NE 186th Street at the intersection with SR 5/US-1/ Biscayne Boulevard to eliminate vehicle conflicts with freight and passenger trains in the FEC Railway, while enhancing traffic operations and safety conditions in the area. Project limits may be adjusted based on the findings of the Feasibility Study.
